name: Chicken Burrito Bowl
description: Seasoned chicken over rice with black beans, corn and salsa. Meal-prep friendly.
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) black beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Toss the chicken with the taco seasoning. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken 6-7 minutes per side, until it reaches 165°F / 74°C. Rest 5 minutes, then slice.
Warm the beans and corn together in the same skillet.
Divide the rice, chicken, beans and corn between 4 bowls and top each with salsa.
